ios.desc:
Train smarter. Eat smarter. Live stronger.

FitWit AI is the all-in-one fitness and nutrition app that puts an AI personal trainer and an AI nutritionist in your pocket. Get custom workout plans that adapt to your progress, track every meal with just a photo, and chat with intelligent coaches who understand your body, your goals, and your lifestyle.

ADAPTIVE WORKOUT PLANS
No more cookie-cutter routines. FitWit AI creates a fully personalized workout plan based on your specific goals, whether that's building muscle, burning fat, gaining strength, or improving endurance. Tell us your fitness level, where you work out, and what equipment you have, and we'll build a plan that fits your life.

AI CHEF - YOUR NUTRITION COACH
Training is only half the equation. AI Chef is your dedicated nutrition coach built right into the app. It knows your fitness goals, your calorie targets, your macros, and your dietary preferences. Ask it for high-protein dinner ideas, a quick post-workout snack under 200 calories, or a full meal plan for tomorrow. Every suggestion is tailored to your daily targets, your progress, and your preferences. It's like having a nutritionist available 24/7.

SNAP & LOG - MEAL TRACKING WITH AI VISION
Stop searching food databases and guessing portion sizes. Just point your camera at your plate and let AI do the work. Snap & Log identifies every item, estimates calories, protein, carbs, and fat, and adds it all to your daily log with a single tap. Works with home-cooked meals, restaurant dishes, and packaged foods.

COMPLETE NUTRITION DASHBOARD
Set daily calorie and macro targets. Log meals manually, by photo, or through AI Chef. View your daily summary with progress rings and meal-by-meal breakdowns. Build nutrition streaks to stay consistent. Your step count syncs automatically from Apple Health with walking calories included in your daily burn.

AI TRAINER CHAT
Your AI trainer is deeply connected to your workout data. Ask it to modify your plan and apply changes with one tap. Get exercise recommendations based on your equipment and experience. Review your history and receive insights on your progress. The trainer remembers your full conversation and gives contextually relevant advice powered by expert-level fitness knowledge.

APPLE WATCH & LIVE ACTIVITIES
Your workout follows you everywhere. Track in real time from your Apple Watch with automatic HealthKit recording. See your rest timer countdown on Dynamic Island and Lock Screen. Use quick actio

quotes.text: I spent a month to put together a workout app without writing a single line of code by hand. It's on par with many apps like Fitbod or Fitness AI. Got approved on iOS App Store. Let me know if you want free access, only thing I ask is to give me genuine feedback and one feature you would like to see. I will be asking Codex/Claude to rank the top features and implement it.
